Mogy Joel R Investment Counsel Inc. lessened its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.1% during the first its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 223,916 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 4,722 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 5.8% of Mogy Joel R Investment Counsel Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Mogy Joel R Investment Counsel Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $37,569,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Stratos Wealth Partners LTD. purchased a new position in Apple in the third quarter valued at approximately $31,574,000. Sfmg LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 1.4% in the third quarter. Sfmg LLC now owns 67,006 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,327,000 after purchasing an additional 931 shares during the last quarter. Kiwi Wealth Investments Limited Partnership lifted its stake in Apple by 36.4% in the third quarter. Kiwi Wealth Investments Limited Partnership now owns 175,436 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,038,000 after purchasing an additional 46,863 shares during the last quarter. Bank Hapoalim BM lifted its stake in Apple by 62.7% in the third quarter. Bank Hapoalim BM now owns 37,074 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,714,000 after purchasing an additional 14,284 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 4.4% in the third quarter. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. now owns 928,291 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $143,068,000 after purchasing an additional 39,391 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.04% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Apple opened at $184.92 on Monday, according to MarketBeat Ratings . The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. The stock has a market cap of $938.29 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 20.08, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $142.28 and a 12-month high of $194.20.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $2.10 earnings per share. sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its board has authorized a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization permits the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are typically an indication that the company’s management believes its stock is undervalued.
Several research firms recently commented on AAPL. Vetr downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $184.49 price objective on the stock. in a research note on Tuesday, February 27th. Rosenblatt Securities reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Monness Crespi & Hardt began coverage on Apple in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $235.00 price objective on the stock. Zacks Investment Research downgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. Finally, Morgan Stanley dropped their price objective on Apple from $203.00 to $200.00 and set an “overweight” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, April 20th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $206.89.
